Name: Isolated assistance
Characteristics: Informal intent, authority, and evidence; no delegated state-changing authority

Name: Registered agents
Characteristics: Agent identity, ownership, inventory, and basic logs
Progression Evidence: Agent inventory and attributable activity logs

Name: Bounded delegation
Characteristics: Intent Envelopes, authority profiles, autonomy classification, policy decisions, and human approvals

Name: Governed execution
Characteristics: Durable cross-domain orchestration, complete traces, tested recovery, proportional autonomy, BAR realization reviews
Progression Evidence: Controlled pilot outcomes and recovery evidence

Name: Adaptive enterprise agents
Characteristics: Reusable capabilities, contracts, controls, evaluations, and adaptive autonomy inside governed limits
